description: In the heart of one of Paris' most beautiful neighborhoods, just steps away from the Trocadéro and the iconic Eiffel Tower, this magnificent 650 m² private mansion, surrounded by a lush garden, offers a true oasis of greenery and tranquility.The spaceUpon entering, the spacious and light-filled living areas invite you to admire the carefully curated decor, leading to a fully equipped, modern kitchen. A splendid marble staircase, with art-deco accents, guides you through the various levels of the residence.Each of the seven bedrooms, with views of the garden, blends elegance, serenity, and ultimate comfort. The first floor houses two vast Master Suites, with King Size and Queen Size beds, en-suite bathrooms and dressing rooms. The second floor offers four further refined, beautifully decorated bedrooms and two bathrooms.On the lower level, a large fitness room with professional equipment, an additional bedroom with two queen-size beds and bathroom open onto the garden. Natural light floods into the house through a stunning skylight, creating a true well of light that bathes every corner of this exceptional residence.To make your stay perfectly pleasant, a daily cleaning service is provided by our teams.For your convenience, the villa is fully equipped (see list of amenities). Upon your arrival, you will find still and sparkling water, as well as a selection of coffees and teas. Our concierge team is at your disposal for any request: private chauffeur transfers, grocery shopping, restaurant recommendations, guided tours, and any other bespoke services.Whether you are with family, friends or on a business trip, this luxury setting will offer you an incomparable setting for a memorable Parisian getaway.Enjoy your stay at HIGHSTAY.Other things to noteTailoring each visit to
